proposed_rules.trigger: A recurring end-of-page zone (rc2) with a CTA heading and a pipe-only link row, identical at the bottom of every page.
proposed_rules.decision: Exclude from per-page block inventory; model as a global footer fragment/site-wide chrome, analogous to the confirmed knack-announcement-bar rule.
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical structure across every page examined in this batch.

proposed_rules.trigger: 'Join ... users' heading immediately followed by a 5xN grid near the top of a solution page.
proposed_rules.decision: Emit as one 'trust-badges' block, one row per badge/item. Rejected alternative: a generic unnamed logo/card grid.
proposed_rules.rationale: Recurs with identical shape across multiple solution pages; reinforces the already-proposed rulebook candidate.

proposed_rules.trigger: A [bg:color] panel next to a [bg:image] panel with zero captured text.
proposed_rules.decision: Flag for Phase 2 targeted extraction rather than treating as a pure decorative background. Rejected alternative: full-width-image-behind-text section mapping (no text to overlay was captured).
proposed_rules.rationale: minWidth capture likely collapsed responsive text normally accompanying the image panel; same pattern seen on C243 and C247.

proposed_rules.trigger: A [4x1]-row header immediately followed by N [4x1]-row data cells forming a competitor feature comparison table (Feature | Knack | Competitor A | Competitor B).
proposed_rules.decision: Model as one 'comparison-table' block, header row + one row per feature. Rejected alternative: an HTML markdown table authored as default-content, since the row shape matches the generic repeating-cards-are-one-block pattern and benefits from block-level styling/decoration.
proposed_rules.rationale: The repeating [4x1] rows are structurally identical to the generic repeating-cards rule extended to tabular data.

notes: solution-4 template adds a dedicated feature-comparison table not seen elsewhere in this batch; otherwise matches the standard solution-page skeleton (hero, trust badges, feature cards, FAQ, global chrome).
